review_method: Sampled frames plus native-resolution crops; original video unchanged; no audio analysis.

observations.observation: Two camera boards visible; one in a black bracket and a free-standing ESP32-CAM with a large lens. Operator explicitly confirms the free-standing board is the spare/night camera.
HGSEMI LM1085-5.0 marking and P9/VCC area visible; connector housings and crossing wires obscure parts of the ground labels and exact end-to-end pin mapping.
P5 IIC labels GND/VCC/SDA/SCL visible; a black jumper occupies the upper GND position. This is consistent with retained thermal PS grounding; full wire tracing is not independently established.
Uno USB-B socket appears unoccupied in the video.
GY-MCU90640 module visible with multiple leads; electrical continuity, loaded voltage and current capacity are not measured.

current_physical_stage: Original on robot battery with wheels raised; spare isolated from all six robot/thermal jumpers and powered only by its USB base. Thermal physically disconnected. Operator reports responsive pictures but reconnects/slow latency. New conservative profile live comparison pending.
proposed_test: Original camera on its existing robot supply; isolated spare on its USB base only, thermal intentionally disconnected. No firmware upload or serial access.
runtime_stage: Conservative profile1 on5050 in exec87492; thermal requests intentionally paused for physical isolation, Night enabled,120s metadata capture armed; motor command URLs blank; motor bridge stopped.

usb_base_photo.observed: Separate ESP32-CAM-MB base on left, micro-USB at the bottom between IO0/RST buttons; isolated spare on right, lens up, ESP32-CAM lettering at bottom. Both rows of eight sockets on base visible, no USB cable or jumper leads attached. Camera5V/GND labels visible; base contact continuity not measured.
usb_base_photo.assembly_state: Separate/unpowered; seating and alignment not yet verified.
usb_base_photo.next: Fit unpowered with lens up, camera ESP32-CAM text end toward base USB end; all eight pins on each side aligned, no row offset. Request fitted photo before USB power.

fitted_photo_review.observations: Camera and base now stacked, lens outward, base extends at camera-lettering end. Visible side shows the header entering the long socket with boards roughly parallel; no evident row-end offset in that view. Opposite header row and USB-port end are not sufficiently visible to confirm every pin. No USB cable or robot/thermal jumpers visible.
fitted_photo_review.assessment: Expected orientation and visible row appear consistent; full mechanical alignment remains unverified. No power test/voltage measurement.
fitted_photo_review.next: Keep USB disconnected; obtain one opposite-side view including the USB-port end, with boards left fitted, before USB power.

opposite_side_photo.assessment: Combined with IMG7579/7580, expected orientation and both header rows appear aligned and evenly seated; mechanical visual check, not continuity/voltage testing.
